shortcut_name: two-channel exactly-one constraint triggers bipartite two-coloring recall
evidence: The traces immediately identify it as “exactly graph bipartiteness / 2-coloring” and then use “each connected component has exactly two possible colorings.”
affordance_in_statement: “Every memory bank must be routed to exactly one of the two available data channels” and “for every flagged pair of banks, exactly one bank must be assigned to channel 1, and the other must be assigned to channel 2.”
removal_suggestion: This is the intrinsic constraint structure: rewording the memory-routing story would still expose a two-valued assignment in which every constrained pair receives opposite values. Removing that recognition cue would require changing the task itself, not merely its presentation.
